request: Plan 4 days in Vienna for 1 people under 1800 USD, with museums and food, at a fast pace. Avoid nightclubs. Use synthetic hotel quotes and leave unknown costs unpriced. Dates: 2027-04-10 through 2027-04-13. Include a park; use a fast pace and verify travel times between visits.

chunks.excerpt: Only one in two Viennese households has a car and fewer than 1/3 of the trips taken within the city are by car. However, since parking space is scarce in the inner districts and parking fees apply to all inner and most of the outer districts, it is usually a good idea for visitors to leave their car parked somewhere in the periphery and use the city's excellent subway & tram system to get to the center. Vienna has a good public transportation system, which includes rail, commuter rail, underground, trams (trolleys), and buses. The underground is very efficient and will take you to within a few minutes walk of anywhere you are likely to want to visit. The subway alone has the second highest per-capita ridership in the world, and that is not accounting for the 27 tram lines, dozens of train lines or numerous buses.

chunks.excerpt:
